name: summary-judgment-brief
description: Drafts briefs supporting or opposing summary judgment or partial summary judgment under FRCP 56, with state practice flagged (California CCP 437c separate statement and summary adjudication, Texas Rule 166a as rewritten in 2026, New York CPLR 3212). Allocates the burden element by element under Celotex, Anderson and Matsushita, including a movant bearing the trial burden; builds the statement of undisputed material facts or the responsive counterstatement (Local Civil Rule 56.1) with pinpoint record cites; raises Rule 56(c)(2) admissibility objections; computes filing, opposition, reply and hearing deadlines from the scheduling order and local rules; drafts Rule 56(d) declarations when discovery is incomplete; and tests sham affidavit, credibility and Rule 56(g) issues. Use for MSJ brief, opposition to summary judgment, reply, cross-motion, statement of undisputed facts, separate statement, no genuine dispute of material fact. Declines declarations that contradict prior sworn testimony without explanation.
